name: Jiten Topiwala
headline: Robotics Engineer & Innovator
tagline: Building the future, one robot at a time.
short_bio: Robotics Engineer with a Mechanical Engineering degree, combining hardware expertise with software intelligence to create machines that matter.
long_bio: I'm a Robotics Engineer currently serving as Founding Robotics Engineer at Agmove Robotics, where I lead autonomous navigation, embedded systems, and control software for sub-20HP agricultural rovers. My journey blends mechanical design, robotics software (ROS2, Nav2, perception), and embedded firmware — with a portfolio spanning award-winning competition robots, industrial inspection systems, agricultural automation, surveillance robots (with a patent in process), and published research in IEEE and IJIRT. I enjoy bridging the gap between research and real-world deployable systems.
